task.question: In the Afghanistan–Pakistan war, what did the government of Pakistan declare on February 26, 2026?
task.evidence: February 26 – 2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war: The government of Pakistan declares "open war" against the Taliban in Afghanistan.

answer:
Based on the search results I found, on February 26, 2026, Pakistan declared that it had struck 22 locations across Afghanistan. According to The New York Times reference in the search results, this was characterized as "Open War" against the Taliban. Pakistan said the strikes targeted militant positions in eastern Afghanistan.

FINAL: On February 26, 2026, the government of Pakistan declared that it had carried out airstrikes hitting 22 locations across Afghanistan, which was characterized as an "open war" against the Taliban.
final: On February 26, 2026, the government of Pakistan declared that it had carried out airstrikes hitting 22 locations across Afghanistan, which was characterized as an "open war" against the Taliban.
